scenes.text: Archaeologists ate honey from an Egyptian tomb.
scenes.claim: Edible-looking honey has been found in ancient Egyptian tombs.

scenes.text: It was over three thousand years old.
scenes.claim: Honey found in Egyptian tombs is reported to be about 3,000 years old.

scenes.text: Honey is almost pure sugar, with very little water.
scenes.claim: Honey has low water content, around 17 percent.

scenes.text: Bacteria can't survive in it, so it just keeps.
scenes.claim: Low water activity and acidity inhibit microbial growth in honey.
